name: Fight for the Throne
oracle_text: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control. Then it fights target creature an opponent controls. When the creature an opponent controls dies this turn, if you control your commander, you become the monarch.
blocked_sentences: When the creature an opponent controls dies this turn, if you control your commander, you become the monarch.

needs.what: a delayed triggered ability created by a resolving spell that watches one specific targeted object (t2) and fires when THAT object dies this turn (once), with an intervening-if (exists a commander you control) checked on fire, then become_monarch for the spell's controller
needs.why_existing_wont_do: delayed_trigger accepts trigger.subject and the loader allows event 'dies' with it (OBJECT_SUBJECT_TRIGGERS), but zones._release_delayed_subject strikes the departing permanent out of every subscription's subject_oids when it leaves the battlefield -- before the dies event is emitted -- so a subscription scoped to the creature that dies is dropped before it can ever match; the card would load and silently never make you monarch. `subject` is also absent from the packet's trigger_keys, and no trigger/condition key compares the dying object against a target. An unscoped creature_dies delayed trigger with controller 'opponent' would fire on any opponent creature dying, which is a different card. Needs the release to keep subscriptions whose event is dies/leaves_battlefield for the leaving object's own zone-change event (or match on last-known oid at emit time), plus a once-only duration
